description:
What is This Part?
This is the New Suzuki OEM Fuel Pump that goes inside the EFI fuel tanks.
* NOTE: Fuel Pump connectors are no longer made like the 91-95 Samurai.
The new connection uses band clamps or wire clamps.
If your flexible fuel line hoses going to the fuel pump are still good then simply cut the original connector off the end and slide onto fuel pump line, then secure with clamp.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Fuel Pump
Qty 1 – Gasket for Fuel Pump
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1991 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1991 – 1995 All Models
